issues.title: An admissible weight-one vector fails property P
issues.quote: Every binary vector of length four has property P.
issues.analysis: The stated domain is exactly {0,1}^4 (paper.tex:10) and P means an even number of coordinates equal to one (paper.tex:11). The vector (1,0,0,0) has exactly four binary coordinates and weight 1, which is odd. It is therefore admissible and does not have P. It is precisely one of the vectors excluded by the program at line 23.
issues.suggested_fix: Withdraw the universal even-parity assertion. A possible replacement is that exactly eight of the sixteen vectors have P, with the code and abstract matched to that true finite assertion.
